svg.title: How a toilet flush tank works
svg.desc: Cutaway of a toilet tank. Pushing the handle lifts a lever, which pulls a chain and raises the flapper, so the water runs out into the bowl. As the water drops, the float lowers and the fill valve refills the tank. The overflow tube catches any excess water.
